task: Fresh literature gate — alternate preprint archives

target_comparator.main: M(4,3) <= 67 for simple exactly-four-uniform families on arbitrary support containing no sunflower of three distinct sets, including empty-core sunflowers.
target_comparator.structural: Every simple exactly-three-uniform 15-member sunflower-free family on arbitrary support contains an actual member disjoint from at least seven other members. rho is maximum degree in the member-disjointness graph, not maximum point degree.
target_comparator.scope: Literature search and claim-scope triage only; no specialist review, theorem validation, manuscript edit, review vote, or publication.

conclusion.bounded_result: No independently authored source claiming the same or stronger arbitrary-support four-uniform upper bound <=67, and no source stating the exact universal 15-triple disjointness lemma, was identified in the retrieved material from this subtask.
conclusion.limitation: This is a bounded search result, not evidence that no such paper exists, and not global novelty certification. Indexing gaps, inaccessible primary texts, and broad native-search semantics remain explicit.
concrete_unresolved_leads: SSRN 6913500: topical 2026 paper; indexed primary abstract read, full text unavailable (403). Abstract does not state a finite rank-four bound; unseen full text cannot be excluded.

Zenodo 18248679: secondary Synapse record suggests a version 2 of Mitchell's power-set sunflower paper; primary page/API/DOI retrieval failed. Version/date and full scope of that Zenodo record are not primary-verified.
